title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. فروری 2015 کو جمعہ کی رات میں میرے والد کا انتقال ہوگیا۔ 1409 views Q. In answer to question to #570, a book called "Salafiat: Aik Jaizah" written by Shaikh Ramzan al-Buti was recommended for self study. Have the ulama also translated his seerah book in Urdu called Fiqh-us-Seerah? Do the Ulama recommend reading of this book? Also, there is another contemporary seerah book written by Shaikh Mohamad Al Ghazali called "Fiqh al Seerah". Are the Ulama aware of this book and do they recommend reading of this book? 2339 views Q. A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. 1457 views Q. Dream 1329 views Q. I saw Allah (SWT)in my dearm. 1540 views Q. I had seen a dream during ramadhan, between 2:30am-3:30 am. Myself along with my three children(1daughter 2 sons) are in a strange ground and are trying to leave the ground. Many Very scary dogs are not allowing us to leave the ground. Whenever we try to leave, they block our way from all sides. They are not barking, not attacking but are just trying to trap us in the ground. Please tell me the meaning of the dream. 1346 views Q. Salaam! I believe that niqab is farz. I want to wear it but since I will be the only one doing it in my close surrounding, I do not feel ready to observe niqab during family gatherings. People have been telling me that either you wear niqab all the time or you do not wear it at all. So I would like to know whether it permissible to wear niqab only while going out in the streets or other public places (where there are non muslims strangers) and uncover my face in front of non-mehram relatives (cousins and brothers in law)? I mean is it ok to do it sometimes rather than not doing it at all? 2654 views Q. There is a girl that i wish to marry but i did not know whether i should continue to pursue the marriage or not so i made istikhara and asked Allah to put it in my heart to propose to her, or just leave it. 1377 views Q. THIS IS MY SIXTH EMAIL: ---------------------- Assalam U Alikum, Respected Sir, I Got married On August 19 ,2007 in Kashmir & Since I am working in Dubai.I Got my wife to Dubai and accompanied her back to kashmir during her pregnancy ,She delivered a baby on May 07 ,2008.Again after the delivery of Child ,i got her again to Dubai In sept 2008 .She started coughing in december and as usual i took her to Various hospitals and at last when doctors and we decided ,i took her to kashmir for treatment. Now i want to Know who is the Custodian of Child & what is the solution for Property. My Mother,Sister are alive and My Mother-In-Law is dead but my Sister in law ,father in law are alive. Please let me know who is the custodian of Child and how property will divide. 1327 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 50329 Country: DE Title: dream concerning Isa (as) Question: (1) Shortly before a Fajr prayer, I dreamt that someone told me that there is a call for me from Nabi Isa (AS). I got so extremely excited that I woke up and even after that I was happy and excited (2) As I was young about 18, I dreamt that I was in a tent where I saw the Prophet Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam and talked him. In the dream, I was a child, although, as I dreamt it, I was 18. He told me to take care of the kids out of the tent because he was too busy for that. (3) I saw three lifts and I took the middle one, wanted the tenth floor but got into 99th and then fell down very quickly then I came out very shocked and went the another left on the side and when I went in, the left had a normal velocity and in every floor the door of the left was a bit opened and I read Kalimah Sharif out of the door. (4) I was looking for the palace and after a long search I found it and then I saw the country developed after a long war. Answer ID: 50329 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 264/264/M=03/1435) (1 & 2) The dreams are good and blessed ones. The ziyarah of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) in dream is a blessing. And it is fortunate if the call comes from the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم). (3) It indicates that it is necessary to select the true path after research in order to reach the desired place; otherwise problems and loss shall occur. (4) In-shaAllah, you shall get success in your aims and shall get wealth. Hold sunnah firmly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
